## Problem

<!-- What is wrong or missing, and why does it matter? Link the issue if there is one. -->

## Resulting behavior

<!-- What changes for users or operators once this lands? Add screenshots for visible UI changes. -->

## Validation

<!-- Commands you ran and what they reported. Name the checks you could not run and what they need. -->

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes
- [ ] Added or updated focused tests for the behavior change
- [ ] Exercised the affected flows in a live browser (substantial functionality or UI changes)
- [ ] Updated the docs under `docs/` (configuration, behavior, migrations)
- [ ] No credentials, `.env` files or personal data in the diff
